description: The annotation that activates @PreAuthorize, @PostAuthorize, @PreFilter and @PostFilter, which Spring Boot does not enable by default.
Rules checked before a method runs or, for reads, against its returned object.
An expression that can use authentication, method parameters such as #id and returnObject, and call beans by name.
The exception a failed rule throws; the filter chain starts authentication for an anonymous caller or invokes the access-denied handler for a fully authenticated caller.
A role describes the user, a scope limits what a client token may do, and a permission names one exact action.
A rule that compares an object's owner with the caller, which prevents reading or changing another user's data by guessing an id.
A call from inside the same object that bypasses the Spring proxy, so method security rules are not applied.
